alerts.noAlerts: No severe weather alerts for the next 7 days. Good conditions for routine field work.
alerts.heatwaveDesc: High heat expected for 2+ days. Apply light evening irrigation to prevent crop heat stress.
alerts.heavyRainDesc: High rain chance or 10mm+ expected. Delay fertilizer/spraying and clear field drainage channels.
alerts.frostDesc: Near-freezing night temperatures expected. Apply light irrigation to protect sensitive crops like tomato and potato.
alerts.sprayWarningDesc: High wind (≥ 5 m/s) or rain expected in next 24h. Delay pesticide spray so it does not wash off or drift.

scan.title: Crop Doctor (Leaf Scan)
scan.subtitle: Supported V1 leaf scan crops: Tomato, Wheat, Maize, Rice
scan.supportedNote: Our on-device model is trained on Tomato, Wheat, Maize & Rice leaf problems. For Cotton & Sugarcane, use Calendar, Fertilizer & Profit tools or consult your local officer.
scan.analysingSub: Running TensorFlow.js model + preparing Urdu & English advice
scan.likelyBadge: Likely Match (50–74%) — Take a closer photo to be sure
scan.unsureBadge: Low Confidence (< 50%) — Please consult an expert
scan.stepsTitle: What to do now (Low-risk steps first)
scan.expertBannerDefault: Model confidence is low or this condition needs field inspection. Show the plant to your local agriculture extension officer before spraying.
scan.permissionError: Camera permission was denied or unavailable. You can upload a leaf photo from your phone gallery below.
scan.meterTitle: More photos means a more accurate answer
scan.rootsInstruction: Gently pull one affected plant, shake off the soil, wash if possible, then photograph the roots. Never pull healthy plants.
scan.tipLeafTop: Focus on lesions, leaf edges, and discoloration on the upper surface.
scan.tipLeafUnder: Turn leaf over: look for pests, white/yellow powder, or fungal webs.
scan.tipStem: Look for dark lesions, cankers, cracks, or borer entry holes.
scan.tipRoots: Inspect root color, rot, slime, or swollen root galls.
scan.tipWhole: Step back 3-5 feet to capture whole plant posture, lodging, or field pattern.
scan.tipFruit: Photograph rot spots, deformities, insect punctures, or blossom rot.
scan.quickQuestionsSub: Takes 5 seconds and helps confirm diagnosis
scan.qWhen: When did you first notice this problem?
scan.qRecent: Any recent rain, irrigation, spray, or fertilizer?
scan.retakeTip: Clearer photos give higher diagnosis accuracy, but you can always proceed.
